scenes.title: A Sad Song
scenes.body: One sunny morning, a little fox played in a soft green meadow. It heard a small bird singing a very quiet, sad song. The fox stopped and wondered why the song felt so blue.
scenes.altText: Scene 1 of a story about empathy.

scenes.title: A Broken Nest
scenes.body: The little fox hopped closer and asked, "Why do you sing so sadly?" The small bird said, "My nest fell apart, and I have no warm place to rest." The fox felt a kind, funny tug in its heart.
scenes.altText: Scene 2 of a story about empathy.

scenes.title: Thinking of Home
scenes.body: The little fox thought about its own cozy den. It imagined how cold and lonely it would feel without a home. Then the fox smiled and said, "I will help you build a new nest!"
scenes.altText: Scene 3 of a story about empathy.

scenes.title: Working Together
scenes.body: The fox gathered soft twigs and dry grass. The little bird wove them into a snug nest. They worked side by side until the nest was strong and fluffy. The bird hopped inside and chirped with joy.
scenes.altText: Scene 4 of a story about empathy.

scenes.title: A Warm Friendship
scenes.body: The bird snuggled into the new nest and sang a happy song. The little fox felt warmth in its heart because it had helped a friend. From that day on, the little fox always listened with a caring heart.
scenes.altText: Scene 5 of a story about empathy.
